data.one_liner: A Flutter port of shadcn/ui with 40+ components and no Material dependency.
data.what_it_does: Provides a comprehensive set of standalone UI components styled after shadcn/ui. It includes its own theming engine, multiple style presets, and color schemes without relying on Material or Cupertino packages.
use_when: You want the shadcn/ui aesthetic in your Flutter application.
You want to build an app with no Material or Cupertino dependencies.
avoid_when: You rely heavily on standard Material Design widgets and behaviors out of the box.
You need complex components like native navigation menus or charts that are not yet implemented.
strengths: No dependency on Material or Cupertino by default
Flexible theming with multiple built-in styles and color schemes
weaknesses: Some shadcn/ui components (like navigation menus and charts) are not yet available
Requires opt-in interop if you want to mix standard Material or Cupertino widgets
data.setup_notes: Add the dependency to pubspec.yaml and wrap your app in ShadApp.

alternatives.name: material_ui
alternatives.why_pick_it: If your project requires standard Material Design components.

alternatives.name: cupertino_ui
alternatives.why_pick_it: If your project targets Apple platforms and requires native iOS Cupertino styling.
